Name: Furniture - (CP) (MMAP)Peach's Seasonal Furniture
Author: peachsmile
Description:
请注意：本模组中的所有家具均为人工智能绘制生成。如果您介意这一点，请忽略此模组。
Please note: All furniture in this mod is generated by artificial intelligence. If this is a concern for you, please disregard this mod.

所有家具都会随游戏内季节更替而自动变换外观。
All furniture will automatically change their appearance with the in-game seasons.
部分家具具备互动功能，如秋千和长椅可供坐下休息，灯笼树和星星樱花树会在夜晚发出温馨的光芒。
Some furniture features interactions, such as swings and benches you can sit on, and Lantern Trees/Star Cherry Trees that emit a warm glow at night.
重要提示 | Important Note本模组需要 MMAP (Mapster's Map and Asset Patching Utility) 作为前置。
This mod requires MMAP (Mapster's Map and Asset Patching Utility) as a prerequisite.
请确保已安装 MMAP，否则模组将无法正常工作。
Please ensure MMAP is installed, otherwise this mod will not function correctly.
模组内容 | Mod Content⛲ 水池 (5件)：不规则水池、心形莲花池、五星金鱼池等。
⛲ Ponds (5 items): Irregular Ponds, Heart-shaped Lotus Pond, Five-Star Goldfish Pond, etc.
🏯 亭台与大型装饰 (4件)：花船、秋千、空亭、休憩亭、树下石桌。
🏯 Pavilions & Large Decor (4 items): Flower Boat, Swing, Empty Pavilion, Resting Pavilion, Stone Table under Tree.
🪟 景观窗户 (5件)：河边、野外、庭院、海边、瀑布五种景致。
🪟 Scenic Windows (5 items): Five scenes including Riverside, Wild, Courtyard, Seaside, and Waterfall.
🪑 树下长椅 (5件)：五种不同风格的可坐长椅。
🪑 Benches under Tree (5 items): Five different styles of sittable benches.
🌳 发光树木 (3件)：灯笼树以及两种颜色的星星樱花树。
🌳 Illuminated Trees (3 items): Lantern Tree and two colors of Star Cherry Blossom Trees.
🧱 照壁 (1件)：中式庭院影壁墙装饰。
🧱 Screen Wall (1 item): A traditional Chinese courtyard screen wall decoration.
获取方式 | How to Obtain这些家具需要通过游戏内的家具目录来获取。
These furniture items need to be obtained through the in-game Furniture Catalogue.
安装说明 | Installation[list=1]
[*]请务必先安装前置模组： [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]， [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 和 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23589]Misc Map Actions Properties - MMAP[/url]。

[*]You MUST install the prerequisites first: [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23589]Misc Map Actions Properties - MMAP[/url].

[*]然后下载本模组，将解压后的文件夹放入游戏的 [code]Mods[/code] 文件夹中。

[*]Then download this mod and place the extracted folder into your game's [code]Mods[/code] directory.

[*]启动游戏即可享受！

[*]Launch the game and enjoy!

[/list]
